bodyDescription: This creamy and delicious paté with chicken (40% !) and fine pieces of carrot is complete wet food for growing kittens. The paté contains 100% natural ingredients is completely grain-free and rich in taurine, vitamins A & E and in animal proteins. Krill meal was added as a source of high-quality proteins and essential fatty acids. In addition, our paté is a responsible and sustainable product as our tetra pack has a carbon footprint as much as 81% lower than other packaging and it is 100% recyclable!در هر جعبه ۸ بسته ۹۵ گرمی وجود دارد. هر بسته = یک وعده.
